candidates.reason: Best banner structure: logo, big headline, details and actions read left to right. Flaws: the RSVP Free CTA is a chip the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, so it gets lost among them. The 2x2 chip grid is cramped. The 'Solstice Presents' kicker sits under the logo, away from the headline. A clipped grey missing-asset stub shows under the URL. The can graphic floats as filler between the columns.

Reading order is jumbled: the kicker, subtitle and reserve URL sit on the far left before the headline, and the time/location is stranded on the far right, cut off from its date. The RSVP CTA is buried as the first of a row of identical chips. A stray red dash placeholder follows TASTINGS. The left column of small italic copy is cramped, with dead space around the can.

The square layout is shrunk into the middle of the leaderboard, so every piece of text is microscopic and unreadable. The headline and CTA are illegible, the planet and confetti dominate empty space, and the format isn't used at all.

Same jumbled layout as candidate 2: the subtitle and URL sit left of the headline, the location is stranded far right and the CTA is buried among the chips. It is worse because a broken 'missing asset / partner' placeholder with clipped red text sits in the chip row, collides with TASTINGS and looks plainly broken.
